$comment: Machine-checked by scripts/check-acceptance-matrix.mjs, which runs in make check and in CI. Every id is from docs/v1-implementation-plan.md §11.2; every check named here is looked up where it lives, so a renamed or deleted test fails the build. `owed` says what is missing and which phase owns it — the plan's G0-G8 gates and phases A-I.

Phase D: cancellation, reboot, failed-start rollback and uninstall/reinstall on each supported host.

measured_over.note: The full local gate set was run at this commit for the alpha.9 record (unit, svelte-check, both feature modes, rehearsals, race sweep, 20-run voice loop). Per-check last-run detail lives in the release record and ledger; dimensions are the same each run, and a stale entry here is a review failure, so it is not a build failure.
